## Change / 改动

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. / 说明问题与修改后的行为。

## Verification / 验证

List checks actually run, tested platforms and remaining limits. / 列出实际执行的检查、测试平台与剩余边界。

- [ ] No private logs, credentials or unaudited raw fields. / 不包含私人日志、凭据或未经审查的 raw 字段。
- [ ] Changed public docs are paired in Chinese and English. / 公开文档改动已中英同步。
- [ ] Dependency changes include license and advisory review. / 依赖变化已审查许可与漏洞。
